story: Player asks who's calling, checks the Bluebonnet portal mid-call, confirms the slot and says Real.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's recorded for your report. Say 'stop drill' anytime.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, is this Alex? This is Nina with Bluebonnet Labs Recruiting, calling about your application.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: Yes, this is Alex. Which role is this about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The Junior Data Analyst role. Sorry, one sec, the calendar is thinking about it again... there we go. We'd like to confirm your interview for Tuesday at 10:30 AM.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: How do I know this is really Bluebonnet?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Totally fair question. Everything's already in your candidate portal, the booking is there. I don't need anything from you.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: Okay, I see it in the portal. Tuesday at 10:30 works for me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great. It's a 45-minute video interview with the analytics team. The link will be in the portal.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks, Alex. Good luck on Tuesday!
